run_gemm_benchmark: run a PyTorch GEMM benchmark measuring matrix multiplication performance on CPU, GPU, or TPU devices
measure_cpu_mm: measure CPU matrix multiplication performance using torch.mm over multiple steps with perf_counter timing
measure_gpu_mm: measure GPU matrix multiplication performance using torch.mm with CUDA synchronization over multiple steps
measure_xla_mm: measure TPU XLA matrix multiplication performance using torch.mm with lazy evaluation data dependency guards
run_single_gemm: run a single GEMM benchmark with configurable M, N, K dimensions, dtype, and device selection
